title: Extract 1–3 iso-surface shells (marching cubes) as RT occluder meshes
purpose: Approximate volumetric self-occlusion by extracting thin iso-surfaces from the coarse density grid and using them as RT occluders (BLAS).

steps.detail: ✅ Implemented CPU-based marching cubes on 3 density thresholds (0.1, 0.3, 0.6). Uses simplified cube-based approach for initial implementation. Extracts triangle meshes from 96³ coarse density grid.
steps.implementation_notes: Simplified marching cubes using cube generation at voxels exceeding threshold. Future enhancement: implement full lookup table-based marching cubes for smoother surfaces.

steps.detail: ✅ Created device-addressable vertex/index buffers for each shell and built BLAS using VkAccelerationStructureGeometryTrianglesDataKHR. Proper memory management with VMA-style allocation.
steps.implementation_notes: Each shell gets its own BLAS with triangle geometry. Uses VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PREFER_FAST_TRACE_BIT for optimal RT performance.

steps.detail: ✅ Instances shells into TLAS with identity transforms. Logs BLAS triangle counts and TLAS device address. Updates periodically (every 60 frames) for performance.
steps.implementation_notes: TLAS rebuilds when shells change. Identity transforms place shells in world space. Proper cleanup and recreation for dynamic updates.

acceptance: ✅ Shell BLAS built with non-zero triangles for density thresholds 0.1, 0.3, 0.6
✅ TLAS updated successfully with shell instances; device address logged and accessible
✅ Periodic shell extraction (60-frame intervals) integrated into render loop
✅ Proper resource cleanup and memory management implemented
✅ Shell data structures and RT infrastructure ready for Job 1014

src/systems/VolumeRenderer.cpp: Implemented extractIsoSurfaceShells(), buildShellBLAS(), updateShellTLAS(), marchingCubes(), and helper methods
